author: Carver Mead
title: Neuromorphic electronic systems
review_depth: publisher abstract plus primary open PDF opening
mechanism: Elementary silicon physics and relative analog signals are treated as primitives rather than arithmetic instructions.
void_relevance: Physical relative-state and adaptive analog design; transistor-level silicon as material rather than only logic.
caution: No VOID implementation or CPU-wide access follows from the paper.

author: Edward Fredkin
title: Digital mechanics
mechanism: Microscopically reversible cellular automata proposed as models for physical laws.
void_relevance: Contrast exact reversible rule cycles with possible HX89 reversible transformations.
caution: A digital mechanics model is not an analog physical machine.

author: T. Roska and L. O. Chua
title: The CNN universal machine: an analogic array computer
mechanism: Programmable arrays of locally coupled analog dynamics with distributed analog memory.
void_relevance: Important precedent for non-von-Neumann material/state evolution and local coupling.
caution: Existing CNN demonstrations do not confer physical functionality to VOID.

author: T. Roska, L. O. Chua and A. Zarandy
title: Language, compiler, and operating system for the CNN Supercomputer
mechanism: Describes a development environment around a real analog CNN array.
void_relevance: Research tools may remain separate from analog execution substrate.
caution: Historical mention of conventional language and machine code is not a design mandate for VOID.

author: Steven H. Strogatz
title: Nonlinear Dynamics and Chaos
mechanism: Limit cycles, bifurcation, synchronization, phase portraits and geometric dynamical systems.
void_relevance: Useful mathematics for testing physical cycles and nonlinear responses without pretending to run them.
caution: Full copyrighted book not ingested; no chapter by chapter claim.

author: Norman Margolus and Lev B. Levitin
title: The maximum speed of dynamical evolution
mechanism: Rate of distinguishable state transitions studied in terms of physical energy.
void_relevance: Connects physical degree-of-freedom dynamics to state transition observations.
caution: Not a verified method for computing VOID states or tapping x86 silicon.

author: Seth Lloyd
title: Ultimate physical limits to computation
mechanism: Physical information processing depends on energy and degrees of freedom.
void_relevance: Explicit physics-based accounting for proposed CPU-native physical operations.
caution: General theory; not evidence of a particular device implementation.

author: Edward Ott
title: Chaos in Dynamical Systems (2nd edition)
mechanism: Nonlinear flows, synchronized oscillations, chaos, phase locking and dynamical control.
void_relevance: Potential scientific tests for HX89 cycle observables and material coupling.
caution: Not full-text read; do not claim a CPU implements these dynamics as a new computing substrate.

author: Ravikanth Pappu et al.
title: Physical one-way functions
mechanism: Scattering through disordered media creates difficult-to-clone physical challenge-response behavior.
void_relevance: Reminds us that complicated physical response can be used without algorithmically simulating it.
caution: Physical fingerprints are not general computation and original output used digital extraction.

author: Andy Adamatzky, Ben De Lacy Costello and Tetsuya Asai
title: Reaction-Diffusion Computers
mechanism: Chemical wave fronts and reaction-diffusion substrates used for physical processing experiments.
void_relevance: Alternative substrate evidence for dynamics and boundary-driven propagation.
caution: Does not show existing commodity CPU has a reaction-diffusion processor.

author: Arjan van der Schaft
title: Port-Hamiltonian systems: an introductory survey
mechanism: Energy, interconnection and flow-based physical network theory.
void_relevance: Useful invariant/energy bookkeeping for connected RC/RLC and multiphysics nodes.
caution: This is an analysis formalism, not a physical computation engine.

author: D. B. Strukov et al.
title: The missing memristor found
mechanism: Physical coupled ionic/electronic transport can produce state-dependent resistive behavior.
void_relevance: Relevant for persistent material memory versus mere charge-capacitor decay.
caution: A passive memristor in a separate experiment is not present on every CPU.

author: Pentti Kanerva
title: Hyperdimensional Computing: An Introduction to Computing in Distributed Representation with High-Dimensional Random Vectors
mechanism: High-dimensional distributed representations of information using random vectors.
void_relevance: Contrast mathematical dimension from physically independent modes in HX89/VOID.
caution: Vector arithmetic can be software-only; high dimensionality is not physical coupling.

author: Laszlo B. Kish
title: Noise-based logic: Binary, multi-valued, or fuzzy, with optional superposition of logic states
mechanism: Uses physical noise processes and orthogonality as signal carriers for logic values.
void_relevance: Research analogue noise correlations and physically separable stochastic processes.
caution: Do not import binary/multivalue logic labels as VOID physical primitives.

author: Clarence W. Rowley et al.
title: Spectral analysis of nonlinear flows
mechanism: Koopman spectral characterization of measurable nonlinear dynamics.
void_relevance: External diagnostic for actually recorded material/oscillator state evolution.
caution: Koopman analysis is not substrate computation.

author: Peter J. Schmid
title: Dynamic mode decomposition of numerical and experimental data
mechanism: Measurement-based dynamical mode decomposition of flow fields.
void_relevance: Post-measurement diagnostic; used only when there are real acquired traces.
caution: The mathematical operator must not be represented as the compute device.

author: L. Appeltant et al.
title: Information processing using a single dynamical node as complex system
mechanism: A nonlinear physical node with delayed feedback processes temporal information.
void_relevance: Non-von-Neumann timing and physical dynamics; possible path for cyclic physical coupling.
caution: Virtual nodes and external readout can be digital; not inherently a fully analog general-purpose CPU.

author: Cristopher Moore and Stephan Mertens
title: The Nature of Computation
mechanism: Computational complexity and interdisciplinary models of computation.
void_relevance: Helps distinguish structured hard problems from claims of constant-time physical processing.
caution: Full book not ingested or implemented; no claims about speedups.

author: M. Prezioso et al.
title: Training and operation of an integrated neuromorphic network based on metal-oxide memristors
mechanism: Experimentally operated transistor-free metal oxide memristive crossbar classifier.
void_relevance: Strong precedent for charge/state coupling in actual hardware, beyond diagram-level proposals.
caution: Different substrate; some associated classifiers and readout remain digital.

author: Gualtiero Piccinini
title: Physical Computation: A Mechanistic Account
mechanism: Causal/functional criteria for when a physical device performs a computation.
void_relevance: Useful adversarial check to prevent substituting interpretation or a data label for operation.
caution: Philosophical criterion not an engineering demonstration; full book not read.

author: Takahiro Inagaki et al.
title: A coherent Ising machine for 2000-node optimization problems
mechanism: Experimental coupled optical parametric oscillators with measurement/feedback implementing Ising minimization.
void_relevance: Relevant example of physically coupled high-dimensional collective operation.
caution: An optoelectronic machine does not make consumer CPU analog internals generally controllable.

author: Gouhei Tanaka et al.
title: Recent advances in physical reservoir computing: A review
review_depth: open-access review abstract and selected section
mechanism: Surveys electronic, mechanical and optical physical dynamical substrates and readout.
void_relevance: Classification of architectures, tasks and what is genuinely performed in matter.
caution: Some forms train their readout digitally; do not equate with VOID non-digital output.

author: Xiangpeng Liang et al.
title: Physical reservoir computing with emerging electronics
mechanism: Taxonomy of fully analog and mixed-signal physical reservoir electronic platforms.
void_relevance: Evidence taxonomy to compare physical nodes, input/output, memory and device coupling.
caution: Publication reviews multiple devices, not a ready to install x86 primitive.

author: Md Raf E Ul Shougat, XiaoFu Li and Edmon Perkins
title: Self-learning physical reservoir computer
mechanism: Adaptive oscillatory hardware displays self-learning and physical plastic states.
void_relevance: Candidate physical temporal memory/cycle coupling distinct from software weights.
caution: One oscillator experiment is not evidence of universal physical general computation.

author: Gonzalo Manzano, Gülce Kardeş, Édgar Roldán and David H. Wolpert
title: Thermodynamics of Computations with Absolute Irreversibility, Unidirectional Transitions, and Stochastic Computation Times
mechanism: Martingale fluctuation relations and thermodynamic analysis of physical transition processes.
void_relevance: Useful independent energy ledger for loops with a physical dissipative substrate.
caution: Theory alone cannot promote a reversible software cycle to physical reversibility.

author: See publication primary abstract
title: Is stochastic thermodynamics the key to understanding the energy costs of computation?
mechanism: Physical computation analyzed using stochastic thermodynamics and real world implementation assumptions.
void_relevance: Clarifies energetic observables, machine noise and measurement claims.
caution: Not the full text of a physically implemented VOID machine.

author: Phillip Helms, Songela W. Chen and David T. Limmer
title: Stochastic thermodynamic bounds on logical circuit operation
mechanism: Thermodynamically consistent semiconductor model shows coupling of memory retention, heat and operation time.
void_relevance: Design-independent constraints useful for choosing physical state persistence measures.
caution: This is a model-based paper, not physical VOID device data.

author: Jeong-Min Park, Yeong-In Kim et al.
title: Ultralow-Energy Analog Reservoir Computing via Reconfigurable 2-Transistor Memory
mechanism: Reconfigurable dynamic-memory-like analog reservoir using two-transistor cells; benchmark evaluation includes motion-detection simulations.
void_relevance: Recent concrete comparison of temporal material state, analog adaptation and integrated silicon-scale substrate.
caution: Publication is new and must be independently read in full before performance claims transfer; not native in arbitrary CPUs.

author: Lingxiang Hu et al.
title: All-Optically Controlled Memristive Reservoir Computing Capable of Bipolar and Parallel Coding
mechanism: Wavelength-dependent optical response controls memristive conductance and nonlinear physical relaxation.
void_relevance: An example of intrinsic material response and multiple simultaneous physical optical channels.
caution: The article's information coding nomenclature is not a VOID primitive definition; different optical substrate.

author: Ruben Van Assche et al.
title: Real-time optical signal equalization with a silicon photonic spatially distributed reservoir computer
mechanism: Experiments with a silicon photonic recurrent physical reservoir and integrated programmable readout.
void_relevance: Example of actual hardware-native signal processing through optical silicon, useful architecture comparator.
caution: This special photonic hardware is not automatically available through general x86/Arm registers.

author: Alexey B. Ustinov, Ivan Y. Tatsenko, Andrei A. Nikitin and Mikhail P. Kostylev
title: A magnonic-optoelectronic reservoir for physical reservoir computing
mechanism: Spin-wave nonlinearities and optical delay supply physical nonlinearity and temporal memory.
void_relevance: Different physical degrees of freedom for truly coupled internal state in non-von-Neumann processing.
caution: Material and transducer specifics differ from VOID and commercial CPU pathways.
